$comment: The plugin wall. Names and authors come from each plugin's manifest.json (built-ins: the player's src/plugins; store: vestra-player-plugins/plugins); zh-Hans names from the plugin's locales/zh-Hans.po. `kind` is "builtin" (ships with the player) or "store" (installed from the Plugin Store). `icon` is optional (a file under media/); without one the card shows the name's first letter.

text.en: Search YouTube in a sidebar, then play or download a video.
text.zh-Hans: 在侧边栏搜索 YouTube，直接播放或下载视频。

text.en: An NES emulator: load a ROM and play with the keyboard. No games included.
text.zh-Hans: NES（红白机）模拟器：加载 ROM，用键盘游玩。不含游戏。

text.en: Plays a Bilibili link: BV or av number, or a b23.tv short link.
text.zh-Hans: 直接播放哔哩哔哩链接：BV 号、av 号或 b23.tv 短链接。

text.en: The control bar, seek steps, speeds and thumbnails on the seek bar.
text.zh-Hans: 控制栏、多档跳转、变速，进度条悬停显示缩略图。

text.en: Files, folders and links in a sidebar; M3U and PLS; repeat and shuffle.
text.zh-Hans: 侧边栏中的文件、文件夹和链接；支持 M3U、PLS，循环与随机。

text.en: SRT, ASS, WebVTT and more, a secondary subtitle, style and sync.
text.zh-Hans: SRT、ASS、WebVTT 等格式，双字幕，样式与同步。

text.en: Find subtitles on OpenSubtitles.com or Assrt with your own API key.
text.zh-Hans: 用你自己的 API 密钥在 OpenSubtitles.com 或 Assrt 搜索字幕。

text.en: Colour, sharpening, denoising, rotation, deinterlacing, crop and zoom.
text.zh-Hans: 色彩、锐化、降噪、旋转、反交错、裁切与缩放。

text.en: A six-band equalizer with presets, audio sync, tracks and output device.
text.zh-Hans: 六段均衡器与预设、音频同步、音轨与输出设备。

text.en: Save or copy the current frame, capture bursts, export a clip as MP4.
text.zh-Hans: 保存或复制当前画面，连拍，把片段导出为 MP4。

text.en: Chapters and bookmarks as marks on the seek bar; loop an A-B range.
text.zh-Hans: 章节和书签标在进度条上；A-B 区段循环。

text.en: Bind any command of the player or a plugin to keys, clicks or the wheel.
text.zh-Hans: 把播放器或插件的任何命令绑定到按键、鼠标点击或滚轮。

text.en: Recently played files, and resume where you stopped.
text.zh-Hans: 最近播放，并从上次停止的位置继续。

text.en: Install, update or remove plugins in one click; a signed index.
text.zh-Hans: 一键安装、更新或卸载插件；插件索引带数字签名。

text.en: Describe a plugin; the AI writes, checks and tests it with your own key.
text.zh-Hans: 说出想要的插件，AI 用你自己的密钥编写、检查并测试它。
